How it works

Buy once, submit once — then your model is built manually and delivered to you. No account or CAD skills needed.

01 — BUY + INTAKE

Order on Gumroad, submit here

Pick a tier on Gumroad, then complete the four steps above — address, scope, and plans — using the same email as your Gumroad order so we can match them.

02 — BUILD

We pull your brief via Claude

We take your submitted brief into our Claude Project and build the model by hand — existing property first, then your proposed scope layered on top.

03 — DELIVERY

Delivered to your inbox

Your finished interactive model is delivered to the email on your order — within 3 business days where possible. Orbit it, compare before / after, and share it with your contractor or designer.

Backend prototype

How the delivered render gets built

The browser preview above stays in Three.js for instant feedback. Behind it, this prototype maps your brief to a vork scene file — the headless, GPU render engine from voyager-so/vork — so the same choices (materials, lighting, cameras, style) can be re-rendered offline at delivery quality on a GPU workstation, then checked and revised before delivery. This page generates the scene JSON live; it does not run vork in your browser, and no render is claimed until that offline step runs.

1 · Intake brief (this page)→2 · Scene JSON generated below→3 · vork render — std/previs→4 · Review & revise→5 · vork render — std/final + delivery
Scene JSON will appear here…

Prototype status: scene mapping covers property, scope, finishes, roof, lighting, cameras, staging, and landscaping. Photoreal stills and flythroughs are produced in the offline step — the Gumroad flow and manual email delivery stay exactly as described above.
